buildSourceNote: Build 145 carries v1.1.0-rc.22. THE OWNER ASKED ok lets come to attendance, then we need the image also to be viewed while approving also the location, then it shows punched inside the workshop then why manual approve is required what blocks auto approve. ALL THREE QUESTIONS TURNED OUT TO POINT AT REAL DEFECTS. (1) APPROVING A PUNCH WAS OVERWRITING THE PUNCH. An approval payload carries is_approved and no check_in, check_out or face_photo, so it fell through the branch chain in POST /api/workforce/attendance to the final else and ran record.check_in = check_in || timestampStr - writing the CURRENT IST wall-clock over the recorded arrival time, and setting check_in_lat/lng, face_photo_in and face_match_score_in to null. tbl_edit_audit proves it for attendance_id 40 (ABDUL GANI SHEK, 2026-09-16): SELF_PUNCH at 03:51:22Z recorded check_in 09:21, APPROVE_ATTENDANCE at 07:37:34Z recorded 13:07, APPROVE_ATTENDANCE at 12:51:53Z recorded 18:21 - in every row the recorded time equals the IST wall-clock at the moment of that write. His genuine 09:21 punch now reads 18:21 with no photo and no GPS, so the approval destroyed the evidence it approved. Five approved rows carry that signature and two have check_in LATER than check_out. A pure approval now has its own branch and touches nothing but is_approved, status and notes; is_edit remains the one sanctioned path for changing a recorded time, which preserves the rule that nobody may rewrite their own punch. (2) NO ATTENDANCE EDIT WAS REVIEWABLE. logEdit supports before: and the user, employee and job-card call sites all pass it; attendance did not, so 0 of 112 rows carried a before_json - you could see who changed a punch and what they set, never what it had been. Now snapshotted before any mutation. (3) THE APPROVER COULD NOT SEE THE EVIDENCE. ATT_READ_COLS deliberately omits the base64 face photos, but the screen rendered an img from r.face_photo_in anyway, so the Verif. Face column was permanently dead, and Approve posted immediately showing nothing. The list now returns cheap existence flags, and a new GET /api/workforce/attendance/:id/evidence returns both punch photos, the enrolled reference photo, the match scores, both GPS fixes, the REAL geofence verdict computed from the configured polygon (null when no perimeter is set, never a fabricated inside), the distance from the perimeter centre, and the amendment trail - RBAC enforced server-side for the employee and the approver roles. Approve now opens that panel first. (4) PENDING OVERRIDE COULD NEVER RENDER. is_approved is tinyint(1) and mysql2 returns 0 or 1, NOT false, so r.is_approved === false never matched and every punch whose verification did not pass displayed as Manual Entry - mislabelling exactly the rows a manager must review. Normalised with Number(v) === 1; the badge now reads Approved / Pending Review / Manual Entry, and no longer claims Auto-Approved on manager-approved rows. (5) WHY AUTO-APPROVE IS BLOCKED, AND WHY SWAPPING THE MODEL WILL NOT FIX IT. Auto-approval is matched === true && faceMatchScore >= 0.7 && isWithinGeofence, so the location was never the reason - a good GPS fix is only ever a necessary term. The face check sends TWO images in one prompt and the provider rejects it: Nemotron returned HTTP 400, At most 1 image(s) may be provided in one prompt. (parameter=image). The catch block then sets score 0 and autoApproved false, which is CORRECT fail-safe behaviour - a check that cannot run must never read as a check that passed - so every affected punch goes to a manager with the reason visible only in Cloud Logging. DATED REGRESSION: face_match_score_in is 0.95 from 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-13 and 0 from 2026-09-14 onward, introduced by commit 877d3de which moved every AI feature to NVIDIA Nemotron and set NEMOTRON_VISION_MODEL to nvidia/nemotron-parse-2.0, a document parser that takes one image. Verified by direct 2-image calls against the live API with 1x1 placeholder images: nemotron-parse-2.0 returns 400 and meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct returns the IDENTICAL request-validation error, so this is a provider-route constraint rather than a model choice. NOT fixed - it needs a product decision and no behaviour was faked to hide it. (6) SCORE SEMANTICS. A score of 1 is not a perfect match, it is the unrun default on the 22 rows where !employee.profile_photo made the FIRST check-in auto-enrol the photo and auto-approve with no verification at all; 0.95 is a real comparison; 0 is the provider 400. The highest scores therefore belong to the least verified records, so the match percentage is now shown only when a punch photo exists. review_reason is derived from the stored values and shown in the panel so a manager is told why a flag exists. GATES: lint:fabrication PASS (889 files, 0 errors); tsc --noEmit reports the same 9 pre-existing errors (2 EmployeeDirectory.tsx, 6 engines/vehicle-passport/index.ts, 1 lib/auth.ts), none in the files touched.
